influencer_repost.name: Niche Partner / Influencer Repost (Cold-Start Bypass)
influencer_repost.description: Bypasses new-account algorithmic delays by leveraging established pages for paid posts/stories.
influencer_repost.text:
Hey {name}, love the content you're putting out on {niche}. We just launched a specialized contract-automation pipeline via moneymaker and want to feature it in front of {niche} creators.

Do you offer paid reposts or sponsored posts on your page? If so, send over your current rate card—we'd love to partner up this week.
influencer_repost.counter_offer_text: Thanks for sharing! Rather than just a single post for your base rate, would you be open to doing a bulk package of 5 posts for $100 spread over the next 10 days? We'll supply high-converting graphics and direct contract links to make it seamless.

b2b_agency.name: Direct B2B Agency Contract Closing
b2b_agency.description: Pitches moneymaker as an automated contract closing engine to eliminate checkout/signing friction.
b2b_agency.text:
Hey {name}, noticed your team is scaling {niche}. Most agencies in your space lose high-intent deals due to slow contract turnaround and unnecessary checkout friction.

We built moneymaker to automate the contract lifecycle—allowing your clients to review, select service add-ons, and execute contracts instantly.

We're opening a low-friction entry tier for new partners this week, complete with setup templates and webhook fulfillment.

You can test the interactive demo and lock in your contract here: {contract_link}

value_stack_followup.name: Value-Stack Follow-Up (Trust Friction Elimination)
value_stack_followup.description: Converts warm leads who didn't sign by stacking free digital bonuses and offering order bumps.
